title: Athletic-Espanyol: Athletic arrives with four confirmed absences
text:
Athletic-Espanyol: Athletic arrives with four confirmed absences Tu Futbolero en Log in Sign up Back to the board News 🇪🇸 LaLiga 17h ago · November 19, 2026 Athletic-Espanyol: Athletic arrives with four confirmed absences
 Athletic Club host Espanyol on Friday, 20 November, with four confirmed injury absences and Espanyol in 13th place.
 By TuFutbolero Newsroom · November 19, 2026 at 05:09 PM 
 Next match Athletic Club Espanyol Friday 20 November · 15:00 Line-ups, result and where to watch → Athletic Club host Espanyol on Friday, 20 November, at San Mamés Stadium, in matchday 13 of LaLiga.
 The home side is seventh with 16 points from 11 matches and, in their last five, have two wins, two draws and one defeat. Espanyol are 13th with 12 points from 12 matches and, in their last five, have one win, two draws and two defeats.

 Athletic will be without four players through injury: U. Egiluz and G. Guruzeta with knee injuries, and M. Sannadi and D. Vivian with muscle injuries. A. Paredes and N. Serrano are doubtful with muscle injuries. Espanyol will lose A. Calatrava to a knee injury and K. Garcia to a hamstring injury, and U. Gonzalez is doubtful with an injury.
 In the last five meetings each side has won twice and drawn once: Espanyol 2-0 Athletic, Athletic 1-2 Espanyol, Espanyol 1-1 Athletic, Athletic 4-1 Espanyol and Espanyol 1-2 Athletic. Our data gives 45% to the home side, 45% to a draw and 10% to the away side.
